lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Drink slips: juice, milk, juice, water, milk, juice. How many of each drink should the canteen prepare, and which total shows you counted every slip?

FEEDBACK
Juice appears three times, milk twice and water once, so prepare 3 juices, 2 milks and 1 water. The check is 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 slips. The useful information is those three counts, and the order of the slips can be set aside.

WATCH FOR
A common mistake is to treat the raw lunch list as information before the words have been grouped and counted.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
On paper, count each fruit in apple, banana, apple, orange, banana, apple, and check the counts add to 6. Name the fruit that needs the most pieces packed.

Write a short reflection naming one observation, criterion or step you corrected and why.

teach_steps.explain:
Data are raw facts, while information is those facts organised so a person can decide what to do.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner base claims on observation, fair tests and design evidence, rather than guessing from a picture alone. Keep every claim linked to what was seen, measured or tested against criteria.
